top_signals.title: US Yields at Multiyear Highs Bring Buyers to 30-Year Auction
top_signals.summary: Yields on US government debt rose to fresh multiyear highs — stoking demand for an auction of 30-year bonds — as surging oil prices bolstered the case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike as soon as next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Iran likely to reverse-engineer captured US underwater drone
top_signals.summary: Iran will almost certainly try to pry open the captured drone’s hardware, but the platform's software does carry built-in defenses, analysts say.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NATO allies foil Russian subsea cable sabotage plot
top_signals.summary: Russian subs were caught in spring training in Arctic waters to unleash a secret weapon designed to clandestinely disable undersea cables.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yankees, Vanderbilt on the Evolution of College Sports
top_signals.summary: Randy Levine, President, New York Yankees and Candice Storey Lee, Vice Chancellor for Athletics and University Affairs and Athletic Director at Vanderbilt University discuss the evolving college sports landscape with Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin at Bloomberg Power Players 2026 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: MoneyGram launches first stablecoin-backed Visa card in Colombia
top_signals.summary: MoneyGram has launched its first stablecoin-backed Visa card, developed with Rain and initially available in Colombia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
